slices.focus: Ariana attends a neighborhood film screening and realizes she prefers local films with post-film talks
slices.summary: Janelle brings Ariana to a neighborhood screening where the post-film discussion with local elders becomes the highlight. Ariana discovers she prefers Louisiana-made films with community talks over mainstream releases and plans to attend more.
open_loops: Putting one local screening with discussion on the calendar
Keeping a loose informal note of film recommendations
Asking 2-3 trusted people for one local film suggestion each month
decisions: Ariana now leans even more strongly toward Louisiana-made films and local post-film talks over mainstream releases.
